WaterIssue.title: WaterIssue
WaterIssue.description: User-reported water quality issue stored in Firestore and scoped to the authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who reported the water issue.

pwsid.description: EPA Public Water System ID (e.g. TX2270001).

systemName.description: Name of the public water system.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code for the reported water issue.

category.description: Category of the water issue (e.g. Taste / Odor, Discoloration, Lead / Pipe Concern).

title.description: Short summary title of the reported issue.

description.description: Detailed observation of the water quality issue.

severity.description: Severity level of the water quality issue.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the reported issue.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the issue was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the issue was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LocationHistory.title: LocationHistory
LocationHistory.description: Location-based historical water quality snapshot saved for an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who recorded this location history snapshot.

city.description: City served by the water system.

primaryWhySummary.description: Diagnostic summary explaining why the score and contaminant profile look the way they do.

exceedsHealthGoalCount.description: Count of contaminants exceeding their Public Health Goal (PHG).

violationCount.description: Count of recorded EPA SDWIS violations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was first logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/water_issues/{issueId}.description: Stores user-reported water quality issues scoped by userId.

/location_history/{historyId}.description: Stores location-based historical water quality records and snapshots scoped by userId.
